_note: Stillway V2 ring finishes for three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial. Colors are LINEAR RGB (use color.setRGB(r,g,b, THREE.LinearSRGBColorSpace)). Apply 'shell' to material 'Ring_Silver' and 'engrave' to 'Ring_Silver_Engrave'. The brushed normal map and UVs are shared and stay as loaded from the GLB. Values are 3D Designer proposals pending user review. D-085: Silver everywhere = polished. Black and Gold stay brushed and need the brushed GLB (UV + normal map): if one GLB serves all finishes, load stillway-ring-v2-silver_web.glb and for Silver set normalMap = null and anisotropy = 0.

silver._label: Active Silver (D-085): polished, same as silver_polished. Env: paperPolished / nightPolished outside S01, heroV1 in S01.

paper.use: Warm neutral studio for Paper/Sand backgrounds

night.use: Near-black with one cold rim strip; ring shows only its edge

dusk.use: Low ochre sun and glow, dark sky

lamp.use: Warm tungsten lamp light (active when Gold is selected)

heroV1.file: web/public/env/hero-env.jpg (V1, sRGB equirect JPG, same as design/3d/hero-test/env.jpg)
heroV1.lights: DirectionalLight #ffe2b8 2.2 from upper left (-600,700,500) + HemisphereLight #fff1dc/#3b3a1c 0.35 + shadow-only light and ShadowMaterial on the stone, exactly as V1 heroRing.ts

paperPolished.use: Studio for polished metal: warm floor-to-dark-ceiling gradient, several narrow softbox strips of different strength, dark flags between them, a warm card and one ochre panel, so the mirror band shows bands instead of flat grey

nightPolished.use: Near-black for polished metal: a broad soft cold rim with a thin hot core, a faint cold fill and warm floor, so the band reads as a form instead of empty black

_archive._note: Not active. Gold options A and C from the revision before D-079 (user picked B, now 'gold'). Kept for reference; renders in renders/gold-options/.

gold_c._label: Option C - champagne, closest to V1 R-gold

silver_brushed._note: Brushed silver (D-071/D-078), archived by D-085. Uses the brushed GLB (UV + normal map).

silver_polished._label: Silver polished (D-081, S01): same as the V1 hero silver, no brushing. Prefer the GLB stillway-ring-v2-silver-polished_web.glb (no UV/texture). If applied to the brushed GLB instead, also set normalMap = null and anisotropy = 0.
